description:
Joo-jung was enjoying a peaceful life at work until a troublesome man named Joo-shin suddenly appeared! As an intern, Joo-shin causes trouble at every turn and constantly picks fights with Joo-jung over the smallest things...

As his mentor, Joo-jung tries her best to be nice to Joo-shin in order to turn him into a competent employee who can actually pull his own weight.

But then...

“Manager, why did you change your number?”
